promise: This car makes you feel powerful.

avoid: brand logos other than the product

cinematography.camera: low-angle tracking, wheel and dashboard inserts, driver reaction, wide road geography, rapid lateral movement
cinematography.lighting: neon night or hard golden hour, strong rim light, high contrast
cinematography.style: cinematic, anamorphic flares, slight film grain, hyper-real
cinematography.color_palette: deep blacks, electric cyan, warm amber highlights

beats.name: Ordinary moment
beats.goal: Customer in a relatable, slightly dull place. They recognize themselves.

beats.name: The spark
beats.goal: The car appears or wakes. A light, sound or gesture signals this stops being ordinary.
beats.camera_hint: low angle, slow push-in on the car, 35mm

beats.name: Crossing over
beats.goal: Customer gets in, grips the wheel, presses start. Point of no return.
beats.camera_hint: close-up on hand and ignition, static, 50mm

beats.name: The impossible
beats.goal: The launch. Streets blur, the world bends around the car. The gasp.
beats.camera_hint: low exterior tracking, fast push-in, wide 24mm

beats.name: Mastery
beats.goal: Customer calm and in control, the world responding to them.
beats.camera_hint: interior three-quarter on the driver, gentle handheld, 50mm
beats.sound_hint: music settles into a confident groove

beats.name: New world / payoff
beats.goal: Arrival somewhere aspirational. Clean hero reveal of the car, tagline lands.
beats.camera_hint: pull-back reveal with slow crane up, wide 24mm
beats.sound_hint: final bass hit, single clean note
